items.label: All-Metal Superiority for Heavy-Duty Gardening
items.value: This garden obelisk trellis is engineered with solid iron construction, setting a new standard for outdoor plant support. Unlike common plastic-coated metal trellises that rust when coating peels, our pure iron tubing with screw-locked metal joints creates an unshakable foundation. Perfect as a heavyweight tomato trellis or durable grape trellis, it handles vigorous climbers like beans and clematis with absolute reliability.

items.label: 3 Assembly Methods
items.value: One purchase delivers three distinct garden structures: a classic 6.6ft garden arch trellis for entranceways, an open-topped 6.1ft obelisk trellis for sprawling vegetables, and a compact 4.9ft cylindrical trellis for container gardening. This modular metal trellis adapts seasonally—transition from indoor plant trellis in winter to robust outdoor climbing plant support in summer without additional investment.

items.label: Complete Kit for Every Gardener
items.value: We provide everything needed for optimal plant training: 100 flexible garden twist ties function as gentle plant clips for climbing plants, while 5 Butterfly Garden Stakes add decorative versatility. These accessories transform this functional vegetable trellis into an aesthetic garden obelisk trellis, making it equally suitable as a rose trellis or decorative wall trellis.

items.label: Scientifically Designed Structural Integrity
items.value: With 6.6ft maximum height and adjustable connection points, this tall garden trellis grows with your plants. The unique interlocking pipe design creates exceptional load distribution, making it the ultimate green bean trellis for heavy yields. Its weighted base configuration ensures stability even as a freestanding pea trellis or clematis trellis in windy conditions.

items: A Long-Lasting Trellis for Your Garden：Stop replacing flimsy trellises every season. Built from sturdy, rust-resistant metal, this plant trellis is designed to last for years with no maintenance. Use it as a strong support for grapevines, a pretty garden accent, or even a small privacy screen. It’s the reliable, go-to metal trellis that serious gardeners choose season after season.
